briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ -0.1%, S&P500 +0.0%) with no clear directional signal. Cash on hand ($189.29) is below the $500 threshold for new positions, so we're holding all 7 existing positions and waiting for a genuine risk-on setup rather than forcing a trade.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. On quiet, directionless days like today, disciplined investors avoid forcing trades and instead preserve cash for a clearer risk-on signal.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是暫時保留在場邊、等待良機出手的現金。在像今天這樣方向不明的平淡交易日，有紀律的投資人會避免勉強進場，而是保留現金等待更明確的進場訊號。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices were essentially unchanged today, with the NASDAQ dipping slightly and the S&P 500 flat. This kind of directionless session often reflects investors waiting for new catalysts before committing more capital in either direction.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡，納指微跌0.1%，標普500則持平。這種缺乏方向性的交易日通常反映投資人在等待新的市場訊號，暫時不願大幅加碼或減碼。
